Help the guards to destroy Waeng, the leader of the gang that has been hindering the relocation of refugees.

==Quest information==
===Objectives===
* Locate [[Waeng]] in the sewers and eliminate him.
* See [[Guardsman Tang]] for your reward

===Reward===
* 3,000 [[Experience]]
* 250 [[Gold]]
* [[Imperial Commendation]]

==Walkthrough==
This quest is very straightforward. Starting from the entrance to [[The Undercity]] from [[Wajjun Bazaar]], head right and follow the arrow on your radar. The [[Am Fah]] patrols between you and [[Waeng]] are small, around 4-6 members per group, and are easily dispatched. Eliminating [[Waeng]] himself is the only thing required by the quest.

==Dialogue==
===Initial dialogue===
'''Guardsman Tang'''
:''"These are hard times...hard times, indeed. This damnable plague has spread to all corners of the empire, and we guards have been tasked with relocating refugees from the plagued areas. As if that were not enough to keep us busy, there has been a drastic rise in criminal activity. From what I have been able to gather, a thief named Waeng and his rat-tag group of thugs are responsible for much of the illicit activity. If you will assist us in dispatching '''Waeng''', I will inform the emperor of your deeds."''
{{offer dialog
|accept = Waeng and his thieves will trouble you no more.
|decline = I'm busy right now.
|ask = An informant has told us that '''Waeng''' is hiding in the '''sewers'''. You should hurry before he goes further underground. 
|indent = :: }}

===Reward dialogue===
'''Guardsman Tang'''
:''"I cannot tell you what a relief it is to know that Waeng and his gang are off the streets. Now my men can continue focusing on more important matters, like seeing to these refugees."''

==Notes==
*This quest can easily be completed at the same time as [[Capturing the Orrian Tome]] and [[It Ends Here]], as they're all in the same general area of [[The Undercity]].

*[[Waeng]] is an [[Assassin]] boss who gives players an early opportunity to capture [[Flashing Blades]]
